segments.name: Commercial banking
segments.description: Full-range banking, financial and trust services for government entities, individuals and small and commercial businesses.
segments.evidence: First Guaranty is engaged in a single line of business as a financial institution, which provides a full range of banking, financial and trust services to state, county and local government entities and individuals and small and commercial businesses.

revenueModel.text: Borrowers pay interest on loans and customers pay fees such as NSF/OD and ATM/card charges; interest income is the largest source.
revenueModel.evidence: First Guaranty's most significant reported source of income and expense are interest income and interest expense (see Consolidated Statements of Income).
